title: Locataires et propriétaires
overview: -Housing, a human right or a "commodity like any other"? In this striking case, a group of underprivileged tenants is told that they have the law on their side, but still cannot obtain justice against the landlord. And yet, see how effective the law is when you don't pay your rent. But the tenants wake up, they challenge the system, they spread a standard lease.
